run_linalg_svd: run singular value decomposition on a dask array and return the SVDResult tuple
run_linalg_qr: run QR decomposition on a dask array with mode='reduced' and return the QRResult
run_linalg_cholesky: run Cholesky decomposition on a dask array and return the factorized lower triangular matrix
run_linalg_matrix_rank: run matrix rank computation on a dask array and return the numerical rank
run_linalg_trace: run trace computation on a dask array and return the sum of diagonal elements
